seo.title: Paul Perigault — Cloud DevOps Apprentice, ESIEA Paris
seo.description: Paul Perigault, cloud DevOps apprentice at WeVii, engineering student (Software Engineering) at ESIEA Paris. CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP.

hero.summary: I'm Paul Perigault, a cloud DevOps apprentice at WeVii and an engineering student at ESIEA Paris, Software Engineering major. I build HR applications in Java and Angular, do multicloud R&D in Go and work on CI/CD pipelines and AWS and GCP deployments.
